course_name_original: SENSORI E TECNICHE DI MISURA AVANZATE PER L'INGEGNERIA M (93814)
course_name_en: ADVANCED SENSORS AND MEASUREMENT TECHNIQUES FOR ENGINEERING M

learning_outcomes.text: Provide notions related to the selection, use and performance of different types of sensors, either traditional or advanced, for the measurement of mechanical and thermal quantities.
Understand signal conditioning and acquisition techniques.
Understand modern virtual instrumentation for signal processing.
Apply some of the sensors presented during the course and interface them to data acquisition systems.

syllabus_topics: Measurement systems configurations: active and passive sensors, analog and digital sensors, principal and interfering inputs.
Static characteritics of sensors: static calibration, measurement uncertainty and reference regulations.
Dynamic characteristics of a sensor: transfer functions, order I and II sensors, basics of signal analysis.
Callipers, potentiometres, LVDTs, piezoelectric, capacitance and optical proximity sensors.
Absolute displacement, velocity and acceleration measurements
Resistance strain gages: types, applications, manufacturing and fixing of sheet strain gages, Wheatstone bridge, temperature effect, strain measurement configurations.
Modern optical strain gages: fiber Bragg gratings, distributed measurement techniques.
Scales and piezolelectric and strain gage load cells.
Manometers, piezoelectric, piezoresistive and capacitive pressure sensors.
Infrared methods: pyrometers and thermal cameras.

assessment_methods.method: Bonus for participation in hands-on and seminars activities
Bonus for correct reply to an additional question on hands-on activities and seminars

assessment_rules: The assessment is a written examination with three open questions, at least one of which focuses on static and dynamic performance of measurement systems. A two-point bonus is granted for full participation in hands-on activities and seminars. An additional bonus point is granted for correctly answering an extra question on these activities. In case of a full pass, the grade can be confirmed or an oral examination can be taken.
bibliography: R. Figliola, D. Beasley, Theory and design for Mechanical Measurements, Ed. Wiley&Sons
institution: Università Di Bologna - Alma Mater Studiorum — Laurea Magistrale Ingegneria meccanica
